scientific_integrity: The underlying published homology and inflation theorems are credited; the novel claim concerns identification of the geometric quarter-turn fixed spaces and its board-order threshold. Finite Smith calculations corroborate exact instances but do not constitute a proof for all board orders.
scientific_limitations: The universal PL classification holds for the quarter-turn subgroup only. The sharp first torsion at even board order fourteen follows from a published vertex-inflation theorem and established integral matching-complex homology; this is not a new general inflation theorem. Possible unindexed equivalent symmetry literature is a priority risk. No independent mathematical audit is asserted.
title: Quarter-turn fixed chessboard complexes and the sharp emergence of integral three-torsion
